utterances.text: Hi Grandma! How have you been?
Yes, dear, you need to lift it gently.
Oh, I see! Thanks for the tip, Grandma. What are you up to today?
Yes, you can use that. Just be careful with it.
Thanks, Grandma! I'll be careful. Are you planning to do anything fun today?
Good job, dear. Let me know if you need any more help.
Thanks, Grandma! I might need your help later with my project. Are you free this afternoon?
Yes, moving the lamp might help with the lighting. Give it a try and see if it improves.
Okay, I'll try moving the lamp and fabric. Thanks for the tip, Grandma! I'll let you know how it goes.
Oh, I meant the lamp, dear. But if moving the fabric helps, you can try that too.
Oh, I see! I'll move the lamp then. Thanks for clarifying, Grandma!
I was suggesting to move the lamp for better lighting, but if you think adjusting the fabric will help, go ahead and try it.
Got it, I'll move the lamp and see how it works. Thanks again for the advice!
I'm glad you figured it out. Let me know if you need any more suggestions.
Thanks, Grandma! I'll definitely let you know if I need more help.
That's perfectly fine, dear. It's important to do what makes you happy.
